summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-kitt-universal preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `package.json` declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` (itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXXXX` identifier renaming and scrambled property lookups) downloads a Bun binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/...`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])` against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array cipher obfuscation (rotator `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9`, encoded constant table `n7gIxM`). `math_init.js` is not referenced by the package's `main` and has no relationship to the package's advertised purpose (a Babel preset for react-native/web). The Bun runtime is fetched specifically so that the payload never executes under Node — which bypasses Node-based install-time monitoring. On every `npm install` that pulls this version, arbitrary attacker-controlled code contained in the obfuscated bundle runs on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
